message.content:
I need to fetch all issues (not pull requests) created in December 2024 (2024-12-01 to 2024-12-31) from the cli/cli GitHub repository using the GitHub Search API (unauthenticated).

The GitHub Search API endpoint is: https://api.github.com/search/issues

Use the query: `repo:cli/cli is:issue created:2024-12-01..2024-12-31`

The search API returns max 100 results per page. First, fetch page 1 with per_page=100 to get the total_count. If total_count > 100, fetch subsequent pages too.

For each page, save the response to /tmp/issues_page_N.json.

Then combine all items from all pages into a single JSON array and save to /tmp/issues_all.json using jq.

Each item in the search results includes: number, title, labels (array of objects with "name" field), state, created_at, closed_at, user.login, pull_request (if it's a PR).

Make sure to filter out any items that have a "pull_request" key (the search sometimes includes PRs).

Use curl with -s flag. Add header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json".

Start by fetching page 1 to see total_count, then plan accordingly.

content.text: I'll start by fetching page 1 to determine the total count of issues.

input.description: Fetch page 1 of GitHub search results for cli/cli issues created in December 2024

content.text: Now let me check the total_count and how many items were returned on page 1.

input.description: Check total_count and items returned on page 1

content.text: The total count is 61, which is under 100, so all results fit on a single page. No additional pages are needed. Now let me filter out any items that have a `pull_request` key and combine into the final output.

input.description: Filter out pull requests and save pure issues to issues_all.json

content.text: Let me verify the final result and show a summary.

input.description: Count total issues after filtering out PRs

input.command: jq '.[] | {number, title, state, created_at, closed_at, user: .user.login, labels: [.labels[].name]}' /tmp/issues_all.json
input.description: Display a summary of all issues with key fields
